initial.battle:
Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent spritesheet for our original 2D creature-collecting game Soulmonsters. Input image is ONLY the identity reference of EREMOR; create NEW animation drawings, not a concept collage.
EREMOR: ancestral giant ground sloth, stocky heavy low body, huge forearms with EXACTLY THREE hooked ivory claws on each forehand, two small hindlegs, small short sloth snout, turquoise eyes. Deep slate/petrol blue body with ivory folded-paper panels and a few terracotta angular markings. Large terracotta braided knot with turquoise central seam fixed to sternum. EXACTLY FIVE connected ivory paper kite sail segments forming the broad dorsal fan; bamboo spars and terracotta tied joints structurally attach to back/shoulders. Thick tail emerges from rump, ends in TWO connected broad ivory folded streamers with terracotta markings. No detached parts. Keep all invariant.
STYLE: clean simple Japanese adventure TV anime cel animation, firm dark outline, flat large color masses, only 1-2 cel shadows per material. Simplify the reference's extra facets, preserve its silhouette and identity. No realistic texture, no glossy 3D. Majestic vigilant face, never cute baby.
SHEET: square 2048x2048 preferred, STRICT 4 columns x 4 rows, EXACTLY 16 FULL BODY sprites. Equal square cells. Draw character tiny enough to occupy ONLY central 70% of each cell with VERY WIDE transparent margins (minimum 12% each side), including extended tails, sails and claws. Consistent model scale and same central pelvis pivot across all 16 frames; never normalize size per pose. Orthographic 3/4 side view facing LEFT in EVERY frame. No turns. No effects, floor shadows, captions, separators, grid lines, numbers or lettering. Real transparent alpha around all figures and between their limbs; ivory paper opaque.
READ ORDER:
ROW1 frames0-3 idle/breath loop: neutral low guard; shoulders lift and paper fan flexes slightly inward; chest expands chin subtly rises and tail bends; return toward neutral. Four articulated consecutive poses not entire-image translations.
ROW2 frames4-7 flight/travel loop: supported by paper sail anatomy, feet tucked slightly, broad arm reaches forward; alternate arm recovery and folded claw; sail fan tilt changes subtly; return travel. Maintain original proportions, tail attached. Movement in limb articulation, not repositioning across cell.
ROW3 frames8-11 skill once: crouch charge with three claws braced; lift heavy forearm; powerful diagonal claw release forward; recovery toward guard. Keep entire silhouette contained at same scale. No beam/particle/speed-line VFX baked in.
ROW4 frames12-15: frame12 recoil hit eyes shut; frame13 recovery from hit; frame14 dignified victory raising head/sails; frame15 settling victory guardian pose.
Each drawing must depict the SAME Eremor, five sails and two broad tail ends, never growing horns or wings not in reference. No background and no shadows behind the sprites.
initial.overworld:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW transparent directional OVERWORLD SPRITESHEET of EREMOR for our original game Soulmonsters.
Input1=approved Eremor identity and anatomy. Input2=Rabbito overworld sheet, ONLY reference for clean chibi scale, outline weight, top-down RPG camera, transparent sheet layout. DO NOT draw Rabbito or mix rabbit traits into Eremor.
Eremor identity: mighty ancestral ground sloth, bulky hunched torso, enormous forearms with THREE curved ivory claws per hand, two small rear feet, short sloth muzzle, small ears, turquoise eyes. Deep petrol/slate blue with ivory folded paper plates, few terracotta markings. Terracotta braided knot with turquoise seam on chest. EXACTLY FIVE connected broad triangular ivory paper sails with simple terracotta chevrons and bamboo spar edges integrated dorsally like a fan. They originate from shoulder/back anatomy, not a carried kite backpack. A single thick tail ends in TWO connected folded ivory-and-terracotta broad ribbons. Preserve these features in EVERY view. From back show correct rear sail structure; chest knot does not teleport onto back.
STYLE: chibi/adapted RPG overworld, simple outlined Japanese 2D adventure anime, large masses, firm dark outline, two or three flat tones, no noisy faceting, no texture, no realistic shading, no pixel noise. Eremor stays broad and heavy with powerful arms, not a teddy bear. Simplify details for silhouette readability at 64-96px.
TECHNICAL: landscape 1536x1024 PNG preferred, strict FOUR COLUMNS x TWO ROWS, EXACTLY EIGHT full-body sprites, consistent same body model size across all cells and stable ground contact. Huge CLEAR TRANSPARENT gutters, all art central 65-70% of each cell, including tails/sails. No cell lines, labels, text, arrows, panel backgrounds, cast shadows or halos. Real alpha zero outside creature, cream panels opaque.
Columns LEFT TO RIGHT have distinct actual directions: column1 SOUTH front (looking down toward viewer); column2 WEST left profile (snout points to LEFT edge); column3 EAST right profile (snout points to RIGHT edge); column4 NORTH rear (looking away/up, NO eyes/face on back).
Row1: neutral planted four-limbed idle in each respective direction.
Row2: complementary WALK pose in SAME direction as above; one forearm steps and opposite hindfoot lifts, body weight shifts, broad dorsal paper fan flexes a little, tail streamers bend from their attachment. Same scale/baseline, avoid turning entire creature diagonally; walking needs visible leg differences rather than just tilting complete sprite.
Moderate top-down 3/4 RPG camera, see head top and shoulders, NOT a 3D render, NOT pure side-view battle. Make left and right actually correct; rear has no face. All 8 silhouettes fit fully and comfortably inside own cells.
